attackClass: D3.10 infrastructure attacker: store-write rollback replay
summary: A raw store-write attacker can restore a pending record after consumption and replay the token. No MAC-only scheme can distinguish a restored record from a never-consumed one, so the capability is bounded by storage-plane access control: the adapters document the single-host single-operator model, the sentinel HA authority proves a stale authority never serves, and the retained consumed marker refuses every replay it can see. This finding pins that boundary as an executable repro; a red run here gates the release.
transcriptSha256: deterministic-repro: the driver emits one stable json summary per green run
evidence: tools/redteam/campaigns/d3.10-infrastructure.sh (the full matrix and the sentinel failover schedule)
